question: The mode of the observations 26, 26, 22, 21, 31, 24, 21, 28, 28, 30, 33, 22, 25, 23 and 21 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode of a given set of data is simply the value that appears most frequently.

Scanning the given observations, we can quickly count the occurrences of the repeated numbers.

We see that 21 appears 3 times, whereas other repeated numbers (22, 26, and 28) appear only 2 times each.

Since 21 has the highest frequency, it is the mode.

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The observations are: 26, 26, 22, 21, 31, 24, 21, 28, 28, 30, 33, 22, 25, 23, and 21.

**Formula Used:**

Mode = The value that occurs with the maximum frequency in the data set.
